Priyanka (CSM): Quick heads-up  SummitCare usage dropped ~60% overnight. Their ML lead left Friday; procurement asked for a vendor cost/ops snapshot. Renewal in ~5w. Can we triage asap? :eyes:
Marco (CS Ops): On it. First checks: token validity, IP allowlist, and any tenant throttles.
Ivy (Solutions Eng): Can they run this quick curl from their infra? ```curl -i -H \"Authorization: Bearer $SUMMIT_TOKEN\" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/health``` 401/403 -> token; 429 -> throttled; 5xx -> edge.
alert-bot: [auto] 2025-09-10T02:13:21Z - edge spike us-east-1 02:10-02:18 UTC - ~1.1k requests affected.
Marco (CS Ops): Logs: cluster of 403s at 02:09 UTC, then retries and some 429s during the spike. Looks like a rotated key + retry burst. No billing alerts.
Diego (AE): Procurement has a competitor demo next Tue pushing \"managed connector\" and lower list price. If it's just config we can win them back. Suggest: 1) 7-day Dedicated extension 2) 30m triage with SE 3) benchmark note (p50/p95, token cost, ops delta).
Ivy (Solutions Eng): I'll prepare a one-pager and a tiny harness to measure p95. Sample script: ```python
import requests,time
h={'Authorization':'Bearer $SUMMIT_TOKEN'}
lat=[]
for _ in range(10):
  t=time.time(); requests.post('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate', headers=h, json={'model':'rwd-core','input':'ping'}); lat.append((time.time()-t)*1000)
print(sorted(lat)[int(0.95*len(lat))])
```
Marco (CS Ops): Action items: @Ivy one-pager + harness (ETA today EOD). I'll issue a short-lived support token and flag billing to pause auto-invoice if we extend.
Priyanka (CSM): I'll reach out to the PM + procurement now; offer a triage slot Mon AM. If no response by EOD escalate to exec sponsor.
Diego (AE): I'll draft the benchmark summary for procurement and include finance contact. No pricing commitments.
Ivy (Solutions Eng): Posted checklist: 1) Validate token (401/403) 2) Confirm IP allowlist/VPN egress 3) Run curl/python checks 4) If 429 -> request transient throttle bump 5) Enable KV cache & batching on trial 6) Collect request IDs & logs for support
Marco (CS Ops): Noted. If we extend Dedicated, billing hold required.
Priyanka (CSM): Thanks team. Goal: triage within 48h, benchmark within 72h, and a retention proposal if numbers look good. :white_check_mark:
